description: Occurrence: the owner removed one attention item from a session record (Hub #842). The occurrence's `turn` is the observation that cleared it; `attention.turn` is the turn the item was raised on. `cause` says which evidence cleared it: `resolved`, a known-ID resolution of the item or, for an approval without a request ID, of its turn; `turn-ended`, its turn ended; `turn-retired`, the owner selected a newer turn, which retires the item's turn; `recovered`, the owner's explicit approval recovery, whose outcome stays ambiguous. Expiry and retirement remove the whole record instead.
